instruction: A candid medium-shot documentary photograph of an indoor workshop. On the left, the young man with an afro in a grey shirt (R2) stands watching the man with short hair in a red turtleneck and green apron (R3) on the right. R3 leans over a wooden table, carefully placing a lid on a cylindrical container. Colorful glass vases and a laptop are visible on the table. Bright daylight streams in from a window behind them, creating a warm and focused atmosphere.
